scope: Owned MicroDVD input, style selection and provisional timestamp lifecycle in the experimental document path. Full library migration remains active.

operations.operation: Parser lifecycle and live document correction
operations.behavior: Rust owns raw lines, current/candidate style names, charset, primary/fallback scan decisions, end-correction flags, frame arithmetic, repeated-brace caption extraction and EOF acceptance. The fallback adds 60 with observed i32 wrapping before widening to reference ticks. Style declarations preserve the fallback flag: a later complete caption can become eligible for correction. Correction targets the last stored entry and can precede its start; it does not rebuild segments. An empty Add leaves pending correction active when no document entry exists.

ReadString/IsSpace, primary and fallback scanf, GetMicroDVDStyle, CString case mapping, MicroDVD2SSA and Add/AddStyle remain transitional services. Primary values cross only at count2; fallback start only at count1. The old unused uninitialized fallback end is never evaluated in Rust. Native style adapters use unique_ptr until transfer; charset is captured before AddStyle can retire the adapter. All callbacks occur outside registry loans.

boundary_review.contract: Document-bound never-reused typed IDs under nonblocking registry admission. Constructor/part output capacities are checked before publication. Raw UTF16LE and predicates are copied before registry borrowing; strict booleans, lengths, command/count/phase and required zero scalars are checked. Primary/fallback/ack steps contain scalars only. Snapshots independently own both line and name results, survive run/parent destruction, and carry no native pointer. MicroDVD uses a separate safe session rather than extending unrelated parser phases.
boundary_review.tests: Malformed packet/phase/count/flag, wrong/stale IDs, BUSY, copied input, independent name/line snapshots and parent destruction; all in the existing serialized registry test.

direct_probe.method: Actual STS.cpp and initialized document observer; both empty and preloaded documents, repeated reference/candidate execution. Covers fallback scans and integer extrema, missing braces, provisional end correction, dropped empty captions, style-only and repeated style declarations, native case mapping, charset transitions, ANSI/DBCS, raw code units, errors and final fragments. Complete documents/outcomes/byte positions must match and be deterministic.

rendering.behavior: File/memory opening; actual 25fps CSRI reference boundaries after MicroDVD frame indices are multiplied by10000; repeated/reverse seeks; style-induced correction; provisional/empty captions; missing braces; discarded final fragments; NUL and DBCS. Style-sticky/control and missing-brace/control pairs must render differently.
rendering.corrected_control: Initial samples at ordinary seconds produced equal images for the style-correction pair. The reference stores frame50 as500000, then translates that index to20000seconds at25fps. Corrected cases sample those actual times. Initial reports remain failed controls. Coverage reuses874 unchanged full-corpus cases and replaces all20 timing cases and4 controls with the corrected focused comparison; source definitions, fixture hashes, DLL hashes and canonical control membership are checked.

limits: No production default switch, full format closure, real player/Aegisub graph integration or library completion.
Numeric conversion, native style/font tag formatting, CString case mapping, file/encoding and Add/AddStyle adapters remain transitional.
Finite local MSVC14.44 Windows evidence. Malformed native formatter scans and unsafe reference operations beyond this corpus remain open; no crash/hang/nondeterministic result is accepted as parity.
Pre-Open native simplicity, allocation failure/reentry, non-Windows parity and Miri remain unresolved.
Direct probes initialize observer metadata; default native-document configurations have compile evidence only.

Replace native numeric, encoding, formatting and file adapters with audited system boundaries and safe policy.
Continue complete rendering, public host/ABI and vendored native replacement; retire fallback/raw adapters as callers move.
